correctness.rationale: Every chart of the projective image is identified as an actual coordinate semigroup algebra: smooth off the first row/column, and polynomial affine factor times the prime rank-one determinantal algebra on the boundary. This proves the complete reduced singular locus, normality, pointwise class group Z at singularities, multiplicity, and Gorenstein boundary. The blowup resolves the one-point base locus of Segre projection. The quadrics defining the Segre show any positive-dimensional projection fiber lies on a ruling line through the center; those fibers are P1 and the contracted-locus codimensions give exact smallness/crepancy bounds. Explicit checker.py was run on all 25 parameter pairs a,b=2..6 and checked 375 charts, bounded semigroups and exact rational Jacobians. Finite tests are corroboration only; no complete classification of nonreduced Jacobian ideals is asserted.

value.rationale: The exact singular-stratum classification is geometric: it describes a natural infinite family of normal projective edge toric varieties by explicit transverse germs, local class groups and multiplicities and determines when a natural global blowup is a small or crepant resolution. These are motivated birational and singularity invariants not determined by earlier projection degrees or completability inequalities. No downstream theorem is required for this complete classification to be useful.
